title: Properties
subtitle: Your portfolio: what you have for sale and for rent.

search.label: Search the portfolio

actions.noPublicLink: Publish the property to get a public link
actions.confirmDeleteBody: Its photos, tours and documents will be deleted. This can't be undone.

empty.title: No properties yet
empty.body: Add the first one and keep its details, photos and tour at hand.
empty.searchBody: Try fewer filters or a different word.

new.title: New property
new.subtitle: A title and a type are enough to start. You can fill in the rest later.
new.created: Property created. Now complete its details.

detail.publishHint: While this is off, the property won't show on your site or in the portal feed.

hints.basicos: The first thing anyone opening the listing sees.
hints.precio: The property's prices, not your subscription's.
hints.amenidades: Check what it has. It shows on the web and on the PDF sheet.
hints.ubicacion: Neighborhood and city always; the exact number only if you allow it.
hints.galeria: Drag to reorder. The first one is the cover.
hints.recorridos: Paste your tour link or upload your own panoramas.
hints.documentos: Private. They never reach the web or the PDF.
hints.propietario: Who owns the property and who works it.
hints.exclusiva: The paperwork that entitles you to a commission.
hints.notas: For your team only. They never reach the web or the PDF.

form.titlePlaceholder: House in Providencia with a garden
form.titleHint: This is what people read on the web and on WhatsApp. Be specific.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Tell what the photos don't show: which way it faces, what's nearby, why it's worth it.
form.priceNote: When the operation is rent only, the sale price stays at zero.
form.showExactAddress: Show the exact address on the web
form.showExactAddressHint: When off, the web shows only neighborhood and city. That's the norm for an occupied home.
form.mapHint: Drag the pin to drop it exactly where it belongs.
form.mapEmpty: No pin yet. Click the map or drag the marker.
form.internalNotesPlaceholder: The owner answers after 6pm. The neighbor has the keys.

gallery.dropHint: or click to pick them. JPG, PNG or WebP.
gallery.reorderHint: Drag the photos to change their order.
gallery.empty: No photos yet. A listing without photos barely gets opened.
gallery.watermark: Stamp my logo on the photos
gallery.watermarkHint: It's applied on upload, in the corner. Your account needs a logo.
gallery.watermarkNoLogo: Upload your account logo in Settings to stamp them.

storage.label: Storage used
storage.near: You've used {percent}% of your storage. Consider freeing space or upgrading your plan.
storage.full: You ran out of space: you used {used} of {total}. Delete files you no longer need or upgrade your plan.
storage.tooBig: This file takes {size} and you only have {free} left.

tours.title: Virtual tours
tours.subtitle: A property with a tour gets far more visit requests.
tours.urlHint: Paste the link and we'll detect the provider on our own.
tours.playHint: It loads on click, so the listing opens fast on a phone.
tours.panoHint: Equirectangular photos (the ones your phone takes in 360 panorama mode). They play in our own viewer.
tours.panoUnsupported: Your browser can't display the 360 viewer.

documents.title: Documents
documents.privateNote: They're private: they never reach your website or the PDF sheet.
documents.name: Name

exclusive.title: Exclusive
exclusive.none: This property has no exclusive on file.
exclusive.confirmDelete: Remove the exclusive from this property?
exclusive.needOwner: Assign an owner to the property first.
exclusive.badDates: The end date has to be later than the start date.

owners.title: Owners
owners.subtitle: The owners of the properties in your portfolio.
owners.search: Search by name, phone or email
owners.name: Name
owners.rfcHint: Contact data for the lease only. There's no invoicing here.
owners.cantDeleteProperties: Can't delete: they still have properties in their name.
owners.cantDeleteExclusives: Can't delete: they still have signed exclusives.
owners.emptyBody: Add the owner of your first property to keep their details at hand.

errors.load: We couldn't load the portfolio. Try again.

errors.planTitle: Your plan doesn't include the portfolio yet
